package.name: robotops_trace_moveit
package.description: RobotOps Trace integration for MoveIt: captures the active trace context when a trajectory is enqueued on MoveIt's TrajectoryExecutionManager and restores it on the execution thread, so the controller hop (FollowJointTrajectory) nests under move_action across MoveIt's internal queue boundary — the one residual async case with no public hook. Ships a reusable, MoveIt-agnostic capture/restore helper (TrajectoryExecutionTracer) plus a carried patch wiring it into stock moveit_ros_planning (the ★ async patch, carried until upstreamed). Built on the robotops_trace_cpp SDK core.
